post.description:
The caller (BFF) presents EITHER its workload certificate (the
`bff-delegator` identity — the TLS layer CA-verifies and injects the
subject; the boot-loaded registry map grants `sentin8:delegate:read`,
auth DESIGN §4.3f; group DESIGN.md §3.1) OR a valid M2M Bearer token
with `sentin8:delegate:read` scope. A cert-bound M2M token keeps its
`cnf` propagated to the delegated token so it inherits the binding.
Handle delegate access token.

200.description: Delegated token issued (act claim carried, downscoped)

401.description: Caller not authorized to delegate (BFF cert + scope, or M2M bearer with sentin8:delegate:read)

post.summary:
`POST /device/verify` — the signed-in user submits the user_code to
approve a device sign-in (RFC 8628 ).
post.description:
SEC-: this endpoint **requires a valid session** (cookie or
Bearer). The approving user is the session's user — `user_id`, `org_id`,
and `env_id` are taken from the session, NEVER from the request body,
so knowledge of a user_code alone can no longer mint tokens for an
arbitrary user.
Handle device verify.

200.description: Device sign-in approved (polling grant armed for this user)

401.description: No session — approval requires an authenticated user

get.summary:
The authorize endpoint validates the request and redirects to the Auth hosted UI
(`/sign-in`) with the OAuth params preserved. After the user authenticates,
the UI calls back to issue an auth code. For non-interactive flows (already
has a session), it issues the code directly.
Authorize it.

`GET /v1/auth/consent/accounts` — fetch the authenticated customer's accounts
from consent data providers registered via `sentin8-cli vertical enroll`.
get.description:
This endpoint is called by the Auth Flutter consent page (served on the
provider's auth domain, e.g. `auth.ibank.local`) to fetch the customer's
accounts at this Data Provider. The accounts are displayed with
checkboxes so the customer can select which ones to share (FDX UX
Guidelines "Select Accounts").

Auth looks up consent data providers from the `sentin8_consent_providers`
table (populated at runtime by `sentin8-cli vertical enroll`). For each
provider, auth mints a short-lived JWT with the registered scope and
calls the registered service via its platform domain URL.
No vertical service URLs, paths, or scopes are hardcoded in auth.
Handle consent accounts.

session.

For OIDC connections, generates a state + PKCE pair, stores the SSO
session, and redirects to the IdP's authorize endpoint. For SAML
connections, redirects to the IdP's SSO URL (extracted from the
metadata — when not available, returns 501).
Handle sso authorize.

302.description: Redirect to the IdP (OIDC authorize URL with PKCE, or the SAML SSO URL)

501.description: SAML connection without a usable SSO URL in metadata

get.summary: `GET /v1/sso/{connection_id}/callback` — OIDC code exchange callback.

302.description: Redirect into the app with the issued platform session (code exchanged, user upserted)

502.description: IdP returned an error or token exchange failed
